decision: docs/decisions.md D042 amendment 'Enrichment v3: post-hoc adoption, APPLIED_TO re-declared on the audit scale, MEMBER_OF re-adjudication' (2026-11-25)
disclosure: The PART_OF and link-guard rules are the unchanged v2 rules, adopted on a relative criterion chosen after the v2 development results were seen; the APPLIED_TO criterion was re-declared after its first result. Development checks are not evidence for v3; accuracy claims come only from the fresh E4 v3 audit.

part_of.property_preference: P749 over P361 for the shown evidence; the statement qualifiers (end time P582, deprecated rank) decide

member_of.decision_note: adopted in v2 (85 candidate edges); in v3 these pairs no longer also carry PART_OF

part_of.decision_note: adopted post hoc on the relative criterion in the D042 v3 amendment: dev kept precision 0.778 against 0.592 for the v1 rule on the same 50 edges, 28 of 29 correct edges kept (reports/enrichment-v2/part-of-dev-check.json); consortium parents go to MEMBER_OF so each pair carries one edge

single_paper_same_sentence.decision_note: EVALUATED_ON adopted in v2 (unchanged). APPLIED_TO: pending, decided by the fresh E4-scale development sample of the D042 v3 amendment (adopt iff >=0.80 correct, unclear counted incorrect)

link_guard.guard: title has every token of the entity name plus at least one more (link.narrower_page)
link_guard.decision_note: adopted post hoc on the relative criterion in the D042 v3 amendment: dev accuracy 0.821 (kept) against 0.783 for the v1 links on the same 60 entities, 46 of 47 correct links kept (reports/enrichment-v2/link-dev-check.json)

linking.note: threshold 0.4 is the v1 link threshold (configs/enrichment-v1.json); the guard is link.narrower_page, unchanged from v2
